Wire: to (signal).description: Render a signal's value as escaped text

Wire: expression.description: Render an expression, updating when the listed signals change

Wire: unescaped markup.description: Render markup your own code generated, unescaped

Wire: once.description: Render a template once, with no signals

Wire: with (template).description: Re-render a template when signals change (space separated for several)

Wire: for (list).description: Render a template per list item

Wire: for (expression).description: Render a template per item of an expression's array

Wire: else if.description: Render when the previous if was false and this condition holds

Wire: else.description: Render when the previous if / else if was false

Wire: component (definition).description: Define a component template (multi-word args in kebab-case)

Wire: component (instance).description: Instantiate a component (argument: @signal, @{ expr } or literal)

Wire: on (event).description: Run code when an event fires, with the loop variables, signals and event in scope

Wire: button with click.description: A button that runs code on click

Wire: bound attribute (signal).description: One-way attribute binding to a signal

Wire: bound attribute (expression).description: One-way attribute binding to an expression, re-evaluated when the listed signals change

Wire: bind number.description: Two-way bound number input, the signal holds a number

Wire: bind checkbox.description: Two-way bound checkbox, the signal holds a boolean

Wire: edit a list item.description: Edit a field of a loop item: show it, write it in place, then set the list signal

Wire: listen.description: Add a listener, stop() removes it

Wire: update.description: Set a State from its current value, the callback must return it

Wire: mount.description: Mount wires and bound elements your own code inserted

Wire: flush.description: Render pending updates now, for code that needs the new DOM straight away
